raw.buffDescription: When struck with an Energy or Physical Attack, activate a corresponding Resistance Buff increasing respective Resistance by 20%. When an [k=glossary/energy_res]Energy Resistance[/k] Buff is activated, remove a [k=glossary/phys_res]Physical Resistance[/k] Buff, and vice-versa.
